title.narrative: Strengthening Reproductive Rights and Health Platform in Turkey

description.narrative: The action aims to strengthen the capacities and networking of CSOs in relation to reproductive rights and health, by providing a capacity building program for member and non-member CSOs to increase their visibility, effectiveness, communication, and advocacy capacities in order to be able to better monitor right to health issues in Turkey and to create better links with public authorities in their areas while creating opportunities to that will facilitate their informed and evidence based contribution to those processes.
